summary: Tested full-screen guided practice overlay across all 3 pages (Chakra Cleansing, Water Practices, Elemental Practices). All guided practice overlays launch correctly from their respective trigger buttons, display session timer, step counter, step instruction, progress bars, and all controls. One structural bug found: the overlay (z-[70]) is BELOW the TopNav (z-[100]) so the nav bar remains visible during practice — overlay is NOT truly full-screen.

ui_bugs.issue: Overlay uses z-[70] but TopNav is z-[100]. TopNav (Home | Explore | Sign In) remains visible above the overlay, making it NOT truly full-screen as designed. Fix: change z-[70] to z-[110] or higher in GuidedPracticeOverlay.jsx line 81.

issues: TopNav (z-[100]) appears above the overlay (z-[70]) — nav bar is visible during guided practice session, breaking the immersive full-screen experience. The overlay gradient/background is correct but the nav is always on top.

action_items: MEDIUM: In GuidedPracticeOverlay.jsx line 81, change z-[70] to z-[200] (or at least z-[110]) so the overlay truly covers the TopNav (z-[100]) and creates an immersive full-screen experience.

rca_of_issue: GuidedPracticeOverlay.jsx line 81 sets z-index to 70 (`z-[70]`). TopNav.jsx line 70 has z-index 100 (`z-[100]`). Since CSS stacking contexts use higher z-index on top, the TopNav (100) always renders above the overlay (70). This causes the nav bar to be visible during guided practice sessions, breaking the immersive full-screen UX. Mitigation: increase overlay z-index to 200 or hide the TopNav programmatically when the overlay is active.
